sections.title: Identification
sections.text: This catalogue entry represents Picea abies, Norway spruce; it is the same taxon as the separate Picea abies entry. The two IDs link to each other.

sections.title: Form and needles
sections.text: Norway spruce is a large conifer of European boreal and montane forests, reaching about 50–60 m. Its quadrangular needles, 1–2.5 cm long, are attached singly to small peg-like bases; the secondary branches hang down.

sections.title: Cones and uses
sections.text: The hanging female cones are about 10–18 cm long and fall whole when mature. The wood is used for construction and paper.
